subject: PO acceptance window and split-invoice flow for Horizon Health
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO acceptance window + invoice split requirements

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Procurement has a few constraints we need to lock down before we can issue the formal PO: 

- Our AP system requires PO matching and the ERP can only accept up to 3 invoice line items per transaction.
- We need the ability to submit split invoices (monthly tranche invoices against a single PO) for multi-month pilots.
- Net terms for Horizon are typically Net60, but Finance is open to Net45 for an early-pay discount.

Can Redwood confirm:
1) whether you can accept one master PO and then receive monthly invoice files (PDF + a consolidated CSV for lockbox reconciliation), and
2) what level of PO metadata you require (PO number, BU code, project code)?

Attaching the draft PO for your intake team: Horizon_PO_6789.pdf (attachment).

We’d like to close this by EOD next Friday so Legal/Finance can process.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Horizon Health

--
Attachment: Horizon_PO_6789.pdf (application/pdf, 124 KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO acceptance window + invoice split requirements

Hi Lydia — thanks, and great to hear. Looping in Vanessa (billing ops) and Ben (sales lead) so we can align on the operational side.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can accept a single master PO and issue monthly invoices against it.
- We can provide a PDF invoice for your ERP and a consolidated CSV that maps invoice lines to your lockbox/ERPs for reconciliation.
- Required PO metadata: PO number (mandatory), BU code (if you use one), project code/GL mapping (recommended). If you can include a contact email for remittance notes that helps automated matching.

Operational notes / tradeoffs:
- Our standard monthly invoice cadence works well for pilots; if you need weekly statements that's also possible but increases reconciliation overhead on both sides.
- We can support an "invoice split" approach where: 1) we bill usage monthly, 2) include a CSV export with up to 3 lines summarized per invoice to satisfy your ERP constraint.
- For early-pay discounts, Ben can scope options tied to commit levels.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ben to propose a small discount ladder (Net60 baseline, Net45 early-pay discount) by EOD Thu.
2) Vanessa to confirm the CSV format and a sample export by Fri.
3) Grace to provide a brief PO intake template (attached) and the expected invoice sample.

I’ve attached our intake template: redwood_po_template_v2.xlsx (attachment).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_po_template_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 22 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO acceptance window + invoice split requirements

Lydia — appreciate the clarity. A couple of commercial proposals from our side to make this simpler for Horizon and keep the pilot pricing attractive: 

Option A — Standard:
- Net60 payment terms (no discount)
- Monthly invoices against master PO, we provide PDF invoice + consolidated CSV.

Option B — Early-pay discount (recommended if Horizon can shorten payment window):
- Net45 payment terms with a 7% invoice-level discount if Redwood invoices are paid within 45 days.
- Monthly invoices as above; Redwood will absorb additional reconciliation work for first three months (onboarding).

Option C — Committed pilot (larger discount):
- 6-month commit with monthly billing, Net60 but with a 10% commitment discount applied to usage over the pilot baseline.

Operational clarifications:
- We will format the CSV so each invoice contains no more than 3 summarized line items to align with your ERP. The CSV will include: invoice_id, invoice_date, line_summary, po_number, bu_code, project_code, remittance_email.
- If Horizon prefers weekly smaller invoices we can support that, but we will need a one-time mapping exercise to ensure proper GL reconciliation.

Ben — can you confirm which option you prefer? I recommend Option B for mutual upside.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 11:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Lydia — thanks, and great to hear. Looping in Vanessa (billing ops) and Ben (sales lead) so we can align on the operational side.
> 
> [redwood_po_template_v2.xlsx attached]

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@horizonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcello Ruiz <marcello.ruiz@horizonhealth.com>, Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO acceptance window + invoice split requirements

Thanks Ben and Grace — good proposals. Procurement/Finance have discussed and will accept the following compromise: 

- Horizon will issue a single master PO. Redwood should submit monthly PDF invoices against the PO.
- Each invoice should be accompanied by a consolidated CSV (format as proposed) for lockbox upload; CSV must include PO number + remittance email.
- Horizon requires PO-matching on invoices. We can accept up to 3 summarized line items per invoice (your CSV approach satisfies this).
- Net60 standard terms will remain, however Horizon will offer a 5% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 30 days.

We will countersign the PO if Redwood confirms the CSV sample and the remittance email the invoices should use. I’m attaching a signed note acknowledging the intake: signed_ma_note.pdf (attachment).

If you can confirm the remittance email and send a sample CSV by EOD Monday we’ll finalize.

Best,
Lydia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Horizon Health

--
Attachment: signed_ma_note.pdf (application/pdf, 88 KB)
